title: The Pickle Pad

services.name: Mini Golf
services.desc: Trade your paddle for clubs. Our golf simulators feature state of the art technology that tracks your swing on hundreds of courses and includes other experiences like football, basketball, baseball, and more. Whether you’re working on your swing or just competing with friends, our simulators take you around the globe without leaving your seat - or your drink. Celebrate tee time in our high-energy bar, where the drinks are cold and the games are hot. Sip craft beers, premium spirits, and hand-crafted cocktails. services.name: Clinics & Leagues
services.desc: New to pickleball? Start here. The Pickle Pad’s new player clinics are the smartest way to get on the court. Each clinic covers everything from serving and scoring to volleys and court strategy - so you’re not just learning the rules, you’re learning how to play the game. Find your pickleball people. The Pickle Pad partners with Honcho Pickleball to bring real indoor league play to our courts and real community to our players. If you’re chasing a trophy or just chasing a good time, Honcho leagues welcome all skill levels and paddle goals. Yep. We’ve got those too.
